lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast white vertical stripes traversing the lateral torso with roughly equidistant spacing, though the gap between the 4th and 5th stripes is notably wider than others.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One visible bifurcation on the 9th vertical stripe (counted from anterior) which splits into a Y-shape toward the dorsal ridge; minor merging of lines near the spine line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several abbreviated segments and dashes are present between major vertical lines 6 and 8, terminating mid-torso without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 12 high-contrast circular spots is visible on the posterior flank and upper hind limb, densely grouped below the termination of the vertical stripes.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots forms a semi-linear geometric pattern at the mid-thigh level.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white crescent marking on the lower throat and distinct white spots located on the cheek and bridge of the snout; high-contrast dark fur lining the interior and edges of the pinnae.
